# tomswallapi_proxy_ndp (Resource)

Answers ARP/NDP on behalf of another host (proxy arp/ndp), on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_proxy_ndp" "web" {
  device    = "fw1"
  address   = "2001:db8::10"
  interface = "eth1"
  external  = "eth0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Address to answer for.
- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `external` (String) External interface.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `haveroute` (Boolean) A route to the address already exists, so none is added.
- `interface` (String) Interface the address is reachable through.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Keep the entry in place while the firewall is stopped.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_proxy_ndp.web 42
```
